title: Sample Pancakes
description: A warm stack of buttermilk pancakes with glossy syrup and a butter pat, plated for the morning table.
steps: Pour batter into a warm skillet and cook until the edges set.
Flip and finish until golden on both sides.
Stack the pancakes, top with butter and syrup, and serve warm.
tips: Use a little extra butter for a glossy finish.
notes: A cozy breakfast plate for the cookbook preview.
